title: ChatGPT Ads上线不足200天年化收入突破10 亿美元
content:
According to the latest industry updates, OpenAI's advertising business, ChatGPT Ads, has successfully reached a run rate of $1 billion within less than 200 days since its official launch. Notably, just six weeks into the pilot phase, the annualized revenue had already surpassed $100 million, demonstrating remarkable explosive growth and strong monetization capabilities.
With the rapid growth of the business, OpenAI has also updated its long-term revenue expectations. Faced with both external competition and internal development pressures, it is estimated that the company's full-year ad revenue will reach $2.4 billion by 2026. Looking further ahead, this number is expected to grow exponentially: by 2027, ad revenue is projected to approach $11 billion; by 2030, it could surge to as high as $102 billion. From a per-user perspective, the average ad revenue per user is expected to jump from nearly $3.50 this year to nearly $60 by 2030.
This highly promising business model is not an illusion. As users often naturally articulate their specific goals and constraints behind purchasing decisions during multiple rounds of AI conversations, the ad system can capture more rich and accurate user intent compared to traditional single search queries or information feed exposures. Based on this deep intent matching, tens of thousands of advertisers have already used the platform to reach audiences, covering over 40 countries. Meanwhile, its self-service features are rapidly expanding to regions such as India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.
While the business scale expands quickly, the platform has firmly maintained the boundaries of user experience and data privacy. Currently, the weekly active users of ChatGPT have exceeded 1 billion, while ad placements are strictly limited to the Free and Go tiers. In terms of commercial mechanisms, OpenAI has established strict firewalls: although the system can screen and match relevant ads based on the conversation context, advertisers cannot directly access users' private conversation content, and paid promotions must not alter or affect the objective answers generated by the AI itself.

report.summary: OpenAI广告业务上线不足200天，年化收入突破10亿美元。
report.background: OpenAI一直以订阅和API为主要收入，但成本高昂，探索广告是自然选择。ChatGPT周活跃用户超10亿，提供巨大流量池。ChatGPT Ads于近期试点，初期定向投放，如今增长迅猛。面对谷歌等传统搜索广告的竞争，OpenAI试图用对话式场景更精准地匹配用户意图，开辟新增长曲线。
key_points: 广告业务上线不到200天年化收入达10亿美元，试点仅6周年化收入突破1亿美元，增速惊人。
预计2026年广告收入达24亿美元，2027年约110亿，2030年最高1020亿；单用户年广告收入从3.5美元升至60美元。
广告系统利用对话过程捕捉用户购买意图，比传统搜索和feed推送更准确，已吸引数万广告主覆盖40多国。
广告严格限于Free和Go层级，广告商无法访问私人对话内容，付费推广不影响AI客观回答，保障隐私与体验。
自服务广告平台快速扩展到印度、欧洲、中东和北非，全球覆盖范围持续扩大。
report.impact: 对AI行业，广告将成AI公司重要变现手段，推动竞争与广告技术创新；对开发者，需学习ChatGPT Ads平台规则，可借此为产品或客户引流，但数据使用受限；对普通用户，免费版可能产生更多广告，但因隐私防火墙，广告不应影响回答质量，需关注实际体验和收费变化。
report.tools: 可关注OpenAI广告平台及官方API文档；营销人员可使用ChatGPT Ads进行意图定向投放，同时参考Google Ads等传统工具对比效果；开发者可接入ChatGPT API测试广告集成边界。
